citations.claim: Graph mode computes the warp angle as the signed angle between root-motion delta direction and locomotion forward around the rotation axis.
Manual mode takes OrientationAngle directly in degrees and converts to radians via a quaternion around the rotation axis.
Root bone receives ActualOrientationAngleRad * DistributedBoneOrientationAlpha around the rotation axis.
Each spine bone counter-rotates by -ActualOrientationAngleRad * DistributedBoneOrientationAlpha * Weight to keep the upper body facing forward.
citations.quote: const FQuat SpineBoneCounterRotation = FQuat(RotationAxisVector, -ActualOrientationAngleRad * DistributedBoneOrientationAlpha * BoneData.Weight);

citations.claim: IK foot root receives ActualOrientationAngleRad * (1 - DistributedBoneOrientationAlpha) so feet follow the locomotion direction.
IK foot bones counter-rotate by the same alpha as the foot root to stay flat on the ground.
RotationInterpSpeed drives FInterpTo from ActualOrientationAngleRad toward TargetOrientationAngleRad each frame, clamped by MaxCorrectionDegrees per second.
citations.quote: const float SmoothOrientationAngleRad = FMath::FInterpTo(ActualOrientationAngleRad, TargetOrientationAngleRad, DeltaSeconds, RotationInterpSpeed);

citations.claim: Per-frame correction is clamped to +/- MaxCorrectionDegrees * DeltaSeconds to prevent pops.
Counter-compensate adds the root-motion delta angle to a target and FInterpTo's it back to zero at CounterCompensateInterpSpeed, preserving animated root motion.
citations.quote: float CounterCompensateAngle = FMath::FInterpTo(0, CounterCompensateTargetAngleRad, DeltaSeconds, CounterCompensateInterpSpeed);

citations.claim: MinRootMotionSpeedThreshold gates warping: below it, target snaps to zero and interpolation eases the body back.
LocomotionAngleDeltaThreshold inverts the locomotion direction when the warp angle exceeds it, avoiding 180-degree over-rotation.
MaxRootMotionDeltaToCompensateDegrees skips counter-compensation when the instantaneous root-motion delta exceeds it, treating it as a pivot.
WarpingSpace selects ComponentTransform, RootBoneTransform or a CustomTransform pin as the reference frame for locomotion direction.
RotationAxis (default Z) sets the twist axis; GetAxisVector maps X/Y/Z to unit vectors.
Steering drives remaining error with a critical spring-damper quaternion over ProceduralTargetTime seconds.
citations.quote: SpringMath::CriticalSpringDamperQuat(IN OUT LinearCorrection, IN OUT AngularVelocity, DeltaToTargetOrientation, SpringMath::HalfLifeToSmoothingTime(ProceduralTargetTime), DeltaSeconds);

citations.claim: When predicted animated root-motion yaw exceeds RootMotionThreshold, its yaw is scaled by Ratio = clamp(YawToTarget / PredictedYaw, MinScaleRatio, MaxScaleRatio).
DisableSteeringBelowSpeed gates the entire node: current speed below it skips both scaling and additive correction.
OrientationWarping maintains upper-body facing while rotating the lower body toward capsule velocity direction.
citations.quote: Maintains a look at direction for the upper body (orientation), while rotating the lower body to match capsule velocity direction
